validated_results.title: Breast, colorectal, and prostate cancer risk in the European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition-Norfolk in relation to phytoestrogen intake derived from an improved database.
validated_results.journal: The American journal of clinical nutrition
validated_results.reason: Prospective case-control analysis within EPIC-Norfolk examining dietary phytoestrogen intake, including the isoflavone genistein, in relation to incident prostate cancer.

cases.excerpt: Odds ratios (ORs) for breast (244 cases, 941 controls), colorectal (221 cases, 886 controls), and prostate (204 cases, 812 controls) cancers were calculated relative to phytoestrogen intake.

timing.excerpt: 7-d records of diet were collected prospectively from participants

continent.excerpt: European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition-Norfolk (EPIC-Norfolk)

exposure_measurement.excerpt: analyzed for isoflavones (genistein, daidzein, glycitein, biochanin A, and formononetin)
